fy.title: Amherst - First-Year Applicants (options, deadlines, materials, codes)

test_policy.notes: SAT or ACT is optional for the 2026-27 cycle; the most advantageous combination (superscore) is used; ACT Science is optional. Self-reported scores accepted; official scores only if admitted and enrolling.

requirements.notes: Common App, Apply Coalition with Scoir, or QuestBridge, plus the Amherst College Writing Supplement. Counselor recommendation and two teacher recommendations (English, math, science, social studies or foreign language). Amherst does not offer interviews (InitialView interviews may be shared). Financial aid filing requirements (CSS Profile) were not confirmed on pages checked.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision sent early-to-mid December (no exact date).

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision sent late March (no exact date); reply by May 1, 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for applicants whose first language is not English. Waiver only for applicants who completed the two most recent years of secondary education at a school with English as the primary language of instruction, or who are native English speakers; no other waivers. Amherst offers no provisional admission or ESL instruction. Self-reported scores accepted; official scores required on enrollment.

english.notes: Strongly recommended minimum for tests taken before 2026-01-21; TOEFL Home Edition accepted.
Strongly recommended minimum on the new 1-6 scale.
IELTS Academic; 7.5 overall band strongly recommended.
130 or above strongly recommended; Amherst does not provide DET coupons.

aid.notes: Need-blind for all students including international; meets 100% of calculated need with no loans. 82% of international students receive aid (average award over $84,000 in 2025-26).

ielts.note: No code used; search for Amherst College when releasing results.

duolingo.note: No code used; search for Amherst College when releasing results.

tier_notes.humanities: Top liberal-arts humanities with an open curriculum.
